Title: NETMESSAGE:H.E.V. ENDORPHINE STIMULATOR:  Excellent work!

Title: NETMESSAGE:Nih:\nLooks like an ammunition crate is blocking the hatch to the sewage system.\nWe should find a way to move it, move it.
Translation: Nih:\n看起来有一个弹药箱堵住了通往污水系统的舱口。\n我们得想办法把它移开，移开它。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Trempler:\nAt least our first assault showed some impact.
Translation: Trempler:\n至少我们的第一轮进攻产生了一些效果。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Nih:\nExcellent work! Adam and I will regroup with the others, that way we can cover more ground.
Translation: Nih:\n干得好！我和亚当会和其他人会合，这样可以覆盖更多区域。
